verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents official SDKs in its own SDK/API reference. The Python SDK is modular, with separately installable packages, auto_instrument tracing, tracing decorators and span querying. Python and TypeScript SDKs cover running evaluations, and client SDKs keep prompts in sync across environments. missing for 10: evidence of TypeScript SDK coverage beyond evals and prompts (e.g., tracing and span querying), a documented package-by-package breakdown with versioning, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs.
